scripts.start: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend"
scripts.chatbot: cd chatbot-service && uv run uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.ci:all: npm run ci:frontend && npm run ci:backend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
